claim: The google-cloud-speech dependency can go: speech recognition now runs on gemini-3.5-transcribe through google-genai (platform/speech.py), nothing in src or tests imports google.cloud.speech, and ADR-0005 says the package is no longer needed. Behaviour stays the same without it. The only importer left is the archived spike .engine/artifacts/spikes/voice-stt-2026-10-23/chirp3_probe.py, and .engine/architecture/architecture-map.md:523 still lists google.cloud.speech, which would need a one-word update.

evidence.detail: google-cloud-speech is declared and no module named google_cloud_speech is imported
speech imports google.genai types; no google.cloud.speech import anywhere in src or tests
ADR-0005: the google-cloud-speech package is no longer needed
the slice leaves removing the package as a proposal to the owner, so it was kept on purpose until the owner decides
an earlier cleanup kept the deps because the walking skeleton was not built yet. That reason has expired for this package: the speech code exists and uses genai

Removing a package is ask-gated, so this needs the owner's word. The other three dependency signals are false: google-genai is imported in llm.py, speech.py and _retry.py; google-cloud-storage in storage.py:115 as google.cloud.storage; jinja2 through fastapi.templating.Jinja2Templates at web/server.py:20

traceability: none found: no goal or F13 criterion needs google-cloud-speech once ADR-0005 put gemini-3.5-transcribe in place

claim: speech._text applies the same rule as llm._chunk_text (src/thinkhow/platform/llm.py:189-196): walk response.candidates, take candidate.content.parts when content exists, keep part.text where part.thought is false, and join them. speech only adds .strip(). A change to how answer text is pulled out (for example how thought parts are treated) would have to be made in both places.

evidence.detail: _text: for candidate in response.candidates or []; for part in (candidate.content.parts if candidate.content else None) or []; if part.text and not part.thought: append; join, strip
_chunk_text: the same loops, the same condition, join without strip
the docstring says speech retries the way platform.llm does, through the shared platform._retry. The text extraction was copied and not shared

traceability: M3 A2 (platform owns the Google SDK); no requirement needs two copies
